rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal, temporary capital improvement, or substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal of the unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must receive relocation payments. The amounts depend on the date the eviction notice is served. For notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27, the amounts are $8,245.00 per tenant, up to $24,733.00 per unit, plus $5,497.00 for each elderly (60 years or older) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren).
rules.key_value: Notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27: $8,245.00 per tenant; maximum $24,733.00 per unit; plus $5,497.00 for each elderly (60 years or older) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal of unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation; amounts are set by the date of service of the eviction notice.
rules.exemptions: Relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9, not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.interaction_text: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act must receive relocation payments. The amounts depend on the date the eviction notice is served. For notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27, the amounts are $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62 years or older) or disabled tenant.
